summary: H World Group Ltd filed Form 6-K with an exhibit announcing the date of its audit committee meeting and Q1 2026 financial results release. The audit committee will meet on May 15, 2026 (Hong Kong time) to consider and approve unaudited results for the three months ended March 31, 2026. Results will be published after HKEX trading hours that day, followed by a conference call. This is a routine periodic reporting event with no special-situation elements such as M&A, tender offer, restructuring, or management change.
